payload.instruction: Make this look like a comic book photo
payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

node.question: Compared with the supplied source, does the edited image show visible progress toward a comic-book-photo appearance?
node.criteria: Pass if there is an attributable visible change toward comic-book styling while retaining recognizable photographic subject matter; fail if there is no such progress, including mere retention of the source appearance or incidental framing or tonal differences; unknown if comparison evidence is genuinely insufficient.
node.binding: Compare the supplied source and edited images for progress toward the requested comic-book-photo appearance. Do not require a particular technique or count unrelated changes. Use the ancestor observations as context, but assess the comparison independently.
